purpose: Give an action two purposes or combine two roles.
keywords: N + を兼ねて; N + と + N + を兼ねて
I walk to work to get exercise as well.
I wrote a letter both to thank them and to report back.
I walked around town with them, also acting as their guide.
formation: N + を兼ねて; N + と + N + を兼ねて
restrictions: The same activity fulfills both purposes.
mistake: It describes a genuine combined function, not an invented pretext.
